title: Refusal Behavior Verification Receipt for Word Card Safety Guard

AC-01_path_census.detail: Path census frozen at docs/atlas/word-cards/acceptance-export-path-census.json enumerating export_open_dataset and bypass paths.

AC-02_refusal_behavior.detail: scripts/lexicon/export_open_dataset.py and verify_card_certification strictly refuse uncertified cards, legacy manifest entries, missing reviews, and snapshot mismatches before creating or modifying any dataset files.

AC-03_draft_mechanics_isolation.detail: Draft mechanics export allows isolated generation to data/lexicon-dataset/draft/ without touching public dataset directory, marking artifacts non-certified and export-ineligible.

AC-04_certification_invalidation.detail: Snapshot mismatch between card build.inputs.S and expected source digests immediately invalidates certification and triggers export refusal.

AC-05_independent_outcomes.detail: Independent tests in tests/test_export_open_dataset_integrity.py verify refusal on negative controls and successful export only on valid exact-artifact controls.
